info.title: UK Finance API
info.description:
A UK-based API for household finances, tax, National Insurance, benefits, budgeting, debt assessment, affordability, and repayment calculations.

Authentication uses Better Auth session cookies. Browser clients must set credentials: "include". Node clients must persist cookies from Set-Cookie responses and resend them. Bearer authentication is not supported.
